question: Who rests on every stage by own will in every principle?
premises: In principle after principle, by own will, the god of gods rests upon every stage.
Of full one-self, of full-consciousness-nature, glorious — in scripture declared Bhairava.
inference: The self-willed god of gods pervading every stage is declared Bhairava.
plain_english: In principle after principle, by own will, the god of gods rests upon every stage — of full one-self, of full-consciousness-nature, glorious; in scripture declared Bhairava.
